root_cause.class: FALSE PREMISE IN A FROZEN BOUND -- not a harness bug, not a property of the trained model
root_cause.statement: The derivation V(tau, w) = 0 is correct, but only on the region where the feature extractor is exactly translation-equivariant. That region excludes a 15-feature-cell (240 px) receptive-field halo at EVERY crop edge whose source column differs between the two crops. HS1 was written over w < 54 starting at w = 0, which includes the contaminated left band w in [0,14].
root_cause.propagation: The SAME omission is present in the frozen mask. The mask retains x in [64, 864) px = feature columns [4, 54), which includes contaminated columns 4..14. In that band the POSITIVE cells do not actually correspond, so the treatment itself -- not merely a nuisance main effect -- is corrupted there.
root_cause.why_the_design_audit_missed_it: source_trace.md section 3 DERIVED the 477 px receptive field and section 10 DECLARED the contamination, then argued it was a geometric MAIN EFFECT cancelled by the 2x2 interaction. That argument is wrong for the positive cells: where equivariance fails, V is not zero at k = tau, so the hypothesis has no region in which to hold. The right mask bound was derived from the shift_left fill and the aggregation radius; the extractor halo was never propagated into the LEFT bound.
root_cause.error_class_precedent: the same class as GEOM-002's C3 -- the statistic was verified under the hypothesis and the region in which the hypothesis actually holds was never verified
